about:
Cranbury Laser and Metal Works operates from Monroe Township in central New Jersey. The company was founded in 1991 and remains family-owned and operated.

The shop provides full HVAC fabrication alongside custom metal fabrication, installation, and repair services. Its equipment includes a laser cutter with a 5' x 10' bed, a 1/4" x 12' CNC brake, a 1/4" x 10' shear, an 18" x 22" bandsaw, a CNC tube cutter, and a jig welding table. The facility also performs welding and passivation. Headcount and annual volume are not disclosed.

The company serves customers needing HVAC ductwork, dust collectors, grease duct, custom filter banks, and renovation-related fabrication. It handles plan-and-spec work and supports both new construction and retrofit projects. Specific industry sectors or named clients are not listed.

The business emphasizes its long-standing customer base built on satisfaction and high-quality products, a reputation it attributes to its family-owned structure and in-house capabilities.
